question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is "**characteristics**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The blank 1 will refer to the qualities of equality and freedom as a part of Democracy.
 
• **The most appropriate word to fill blank 1 is "characteristics."**
 
 
• **"Characteristics" refers to distinguishing features or qualities of something or someone.**(विशेषताएँ)
 
 
• Example: Honesty and compassion are the characteristics of a good person.
 
 
 
 
 
• In the given context, it could be referring to the unique traits or attributes of "democracy."
 
• Grammatically, it is a noun that can be used in various sentence structures, such as "The characteristics of X are Y."

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2, "analytics", refers to the analysis and interpretation of data or information.(वैश्लेषिकी)
 
• Option 3, "statistics", refers to the collection, analysis, interpretation, presentation, and organization of data. (आंकड़े)
 
• Option 4, "linguistics", refers to the scientific study of language and its structure, including grammar, syntax, and semantics.(भाषा विज्ञान)
